subject: Draft: Offer letter — probation, immigration, and start logistics
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft offer for Ellen Park - please review

Team,

Attached is a working draft of the offer for Ellen (role: Senior Infra Engineer, Band 4). Highlights: base $200,000, annual equity grant 0.6% (4-year schedule, 1yr cliff), sign-on $20,000, relocation stipend $5,000. Proposed start date: Monday, 16 Aug 2026.

Two points I want resolved before we send:
- Immigration: Ellen is on STEM OPT and will need sponsorship transfer next window. We need legal/immigration language that "Redwood will provide reasonable support for H-1B transfer and associated filing fees" — is that an ok phrasing?
- Probation/first-review period: I used a 90-day probation clause because the hiring manager asked for a ramp period. HR — is "probationary period" acceptable verbatim for California/remote hires?

Please review redlines in the doc (track changes). If comp or sign-on needs adjustment, flag. I also added HC-234 in the header for headcount traceability.

Attachments: offer_draft_kp_v3.docx, compensation_grid_Q3.xlsx

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Infrastructure Hiring
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft offer for Ellen Park - please review

Laura —

Thanks for sending. I made inline suggestions in the attached doc; summary here so we don't lose the key asks:

- Probation language: prefer "performance review at 90 days" instead of "probationary period" to avoid potential legal concerns in CA and for remote hires.
- Sign-on: split into two payments — $10k at start, $10k after 6 months conditioned on active employment. Helps with retention and cash flow.
- Relocation: OK to offer up to $4,000 reimbursed rather than a flat $5,000 stipend; suggest reimbursement with receipts to simplify payroll.
- Immigration: draft language that covers "reasonable legal fees" for H-1B transfer but not filing costs for dependents; that keeps our liability clearer. Include a line: "Employer reserves the right to determine the immigration service provider."
- Start date: can we make start flexible within a two-week window (Aug 9–23)? Candidate indicated she may need a week for paperwork.

I also redlined the equity vesting to explicitly call out quarterly vesting after the 1-year cliff. Small legal ask: include arbitration/waiver-of-class-action? Legal usually prefers a separate addendum.

Happy to iterate — once HR confirms the comp band and HC code, can send to candidate for verbal acceptance then DocuSign.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Recruiting Lead, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
[attachment: offer_draft_kp_v3.docx]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft offer for Ellen Park - please review

Kim/Laura —

Compensation check: base 200k + 0.6% eq + 20k sign-on fits within Band 4 midpoint (Band 4: $175k–$220k). Headcount is approved under HC-234 for this quarter (confirmed with finance). Please reference HC-234 when you submit the final requisition.

A few suggested edits from an operations/HR perspective:
- Background checks and reference checks: initiate after verbal acceptance but before signed offer returned (we've had quicker turnaround if candidate signs intent to proceed).
- Language change: instead of "probationary period" recommend "initial performance review within 90 days" (same as Kim suggested) — easier compliance across jurisdictions.
- Relocation: approve up to $4,000 reimbursed.
- Sign-on: agree to split 10k/10k; make second payment contingent on 6 months active employment.

I'll mark this as "approved for send" once we update the doc and Vivek signs off on equity/sign-on final amounts.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
